name: Morioka
summary: Morioka City Asset Tax Division and the Morioka Legal Affairs Bureau are evidenced cadastral/map custodians. The public Morioka Wagmap viewer was followed through its current HTML JavaScript configuration; its published themes do not include cadastral parcels and no anonymous parcel geometry response was verified.

queryOutcomes.query: Morioka Japan official cadastral map parcel GIS
queryOutcomes.outcome: Official city cadastral guidance, city public map and Legal Affairs Bureau map-information pages found; no open parcel geometry endpoint found.

scopeLimits: No exact-point hit/miss was used as citywide evidence.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or unsafe field request was used.
No parcel polygon or raw source-specific attribute set was retained.
Official registry existence is distinguished from public machine-readable geometry availability.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The custodians may expose maps through in-person, paid-copy, certificate or other request workflows not suitable for anonymous integration. The public viewer's absence of a parcel layer does not establish absence of cadastral records.
serialReviewRecommendation: Hold. Do not enable a runtime adapter until a serial reviewer independently verifies a public, bounded parcel geometry response with CRS and stable native identity.
